theme_and_archetype.vibe: Authority, clarity, function-first, rigid, objective, data-dense.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/Enterprise). Clean, minimal typography prioritizing data readability.
rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing: tracking-tight.
Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase, text-xs, and wide spacing: tracking-[0.2em].
95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
No full-screen gradients. Pure function over decoration.
Use International Klein Blue (#002FA7) strictly for primary actions.
Use Green/Red strictly for Profit/Loss indicators.

widget_ratios: Primary Data/Chart: col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3
rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Strict alignment: numbers in tables should be right-aligned.

component_strategy.surfaces: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts where possible.
component_strategy.cards: Flat solid background, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm / 2-4px), 1px solid border (border-gray-200), NO shadows.
component_strategy.buttons: Rectangular, sharp edges. Primary uses background #002FA7, text #FFFFFF. Hover state must explicitly set text color.
component_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: sharp borders, distinct focus state (ring-2 ring-primary).
component_strategy.charts: Recharts. Use monochrome for general data, strict Green/Red for Income/Expense.
component_strategy.tables: Dense, high-contrast borders. Alternating subtle row colors if data is extremely dense.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp and fast. Slight border color darkening or background tint.
motion_and_interaction.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast, eg: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7] focus:ring-offset-2.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or Regular depending on emphasis. Dense layouts prefer crisp line icons.

images.description: Minimalist ampersand logo for brand placeholder.

rules: NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Use kebab-case, role-based format. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='kpi-total-profit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement bilingual toggle (English/Hindi) in the header using i18n or state context.
Dashboard needs KPIs for Investment, Profit, Loss, Expenses, Income.
Use Recharts for line, bar, pie charts. Ensure tooltips are functional and styled with high contrast.
Role-based access (Admin, Manager, Viewer) should reflect in UI (disable/hide actions for Viewers).
Implement CSV/Excel export/import capabilities as requested.
Use .js files. Do not use TypeScript.
Ensure data tables are dense, scalable, and responsive (horizontal scroll on mobile).
